subject: Emotions
title: Taste Aversion Learning
description: A quick, practical guide to Taste Aversion Learning.

hook.text: Eat sushi before getting the flu, and you may never enjoy sushi again. One pairing is enough.

buildup.text: John Garcia discovered that rats avoid flavors paired with illness—even if the illness came hours later.

discovery.text: This is the fastest learning in nature. One trial, one lasting aversion. No repetition needed.

twist.text: Your logical mind knows the sushi didn't cause the flu. Your gut doesn't care about logic.

climax.text: Ranchers use this to protect livestock. Wolves that eat poison-laced bait stop hunting sheep.

punchline.text: One bad meal teaches a lesson that lasts forever.
